title: 第3章 混沌未分天地乱真灵误入洪荒中第4章 大道之力显神通混沌至宝初现世
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
在混沌的初始阶段，整个宇宙尚处于一片朦胧的状态，时间和空间的概念还未完全形成。
在这片混沌之中，唯一存在的便是蕴含着大道之力的三千魔神，他们正在母胎般的混沌能量中慢慢孕育，等待着破壳而出的那一日。三千魔神，每一个都代表着大道的不同面向，他们既是混沌的产物，也是未来秩序与法则的奠基者。
混沌，作为一个没有形状也没有边际的空间，充斥着无尽的能量与可能性。
这些能量在不断地碰撞与融合中与大道产生了微妙的反应，形成了孕育三千魔神的独特条件。
每个魔神体内都蕴藏着一部分大道的真谛，他们通过吸收混沌中的灵气来成长，直到某一天，当他们的力量达到顶峰，便会展现出各自不同的形态，从而成为独立的个体。
在这个时期，除了三千魔神，混沌之中没有任何其他的生物或意识体存在。
没有星辰，没有生命，甚至连最基本的时间概念都尚未确立。一切都处在一种绝对的原始状态，只有纯粹的能量与无限的可能性在其中流转。
正当混沌维持着其亘古不变的寂静，仿佛时间在此停滞之际，一个意外的发生彻底打破了这份宁静。一道特殊的存在，如同一抹突如其来的流星，划破了混沌的厚重帷幕，闯入了这片古老而神秘的空间。
这个存在并非来自混沌内部的孕育，而是从外界突然降临，它就是林镜的灵魂，一个本不属于此地的真灵。
对于林镜而言，这一切发生得太突然，太不可思议。在他的意识中，他还记得自己前一刻还在现代社会中快乐的九九六中，下一刻却莫名其妙地置身于一片虚无之中！
四周是无尽的黑暗与混沌能量，没有方向，没有参照物，甚至没有重力，他就像一颗孤独的星尘，在混沌的海洋中漫无目的漂流。
本来林镜以为自己只是过于劳累昏迷了过去，可是当他在混沌之中足足漂流了几个小时之后，才明白这里似乎已经不是地球了！
“难不成我穿越了？可是周围乌漆嘛黑，啥也看不见啊！连声音都是不存在的！”
这些想法在林镜的真灵之中不断回荡，可是在混沌之中，他现在连话都说不出来！
随着时间的推移，林镜逐渐适应了这种奇特的存在方式。
他发现，尽管身处混沌之中，但他可以感知到周围能量的细微波动，甚至能够在某种程度上与这些能量产生互动。
但是这并没有什么用，而且随着时间的推移，他感觉自己的意识越来越模糊了！
看样子，要不了多久他的这点真灵也快要消散了！
按照正常的穿越流程，他应该会代替这个世界的某个生灵，或者重生为一个新生灵！
但是现在的情况却很尴尬，这里是初生的混沌世界之中，除了三千魔神，根本不能诞生出任何其他生灵！

而蕴含着大道之力的三千魔神都已经诞生了自己的意识，根本不是林镜这点虚弱的灵魂可以夺舍的！
好在天无绝人之路，在林镜的意识快要消散之际！他仿佛在听到了一种存在于冥冥之中的声音！
“你是……什么？”
“混沌之中，不应该……出现……？”
这声音断断续续，最后变成了一个完整的问题！
“你想要什么？”
林镜此时已经快要无尽虚无的混沌世界逼疯了，弱弱的传递出了一个念头！
“我想要看清这个世界……越清楚越好！”
这一次，那道冥冥之中的声音沉默了很久，最终回应道：
“好！”
下一刻，混沌之中爆发出了诞生以来最耀眼的光芒，三千大道之力朝着林镜所在的方位汇聚而来，如同万川归海，形成了一个巨大的旋涡。
这股力量之强，几乎撕裂了混沌的屏障，使得原本混沌不清的世界瞬间变得明亮起来。林镜感到一股强大的吸力将他的灵魂紧紧抓住，然后被带入了一个全新的维度。
在他眼前，混沌不再是毫无规律可言的混乱能量，而是呈现出了一种有序的结构。
三千大道之力仿佛化作了三千条璀璨的银河，围绕着他旋转，每一条银河代表了一种大道的根本法则，它们交织在一起，构成了一个复杂而精妙的网络。
林镜惊讶地发现自己竟然能理解这些大道之力的部分含义，他看到了时间的流逝、空间的延展、物质的组成、能量的转换……所有的一切都在这三千大道之力的作用下得以显现。
下一刻，还在三千大道之中遨游的林镜回过神来，他发现现在已经可以看清混沌了！
在混沌之中，蕴含着大道之力的三千魔神还在孕育之中，不过他们之中有不少真灵已经苏醒的，也在关注这里发生的一切！
林镜这时把目光也收了回来，看到了自己的身上！
一道华丽古朴的镜子出现在林镜的灵识之中，这面镜子正面光滑如玉，反射着柔和而清澈的光芒，给人一种温润如君子的感觉。
镜面之下，似乎隐藏着无尽混沌，只要凝视片刻，便能让心生敬畏。而镜子的背面，则雕刻着繁复的纹路，这些纹路并非随意刻画，而是遵循着某种玄妙的规律排列组合，构成了一系列复杂的图腾与符号。

这面华丽的镜子就这么孤零零的漂浮在混沌之中，周围的各种大道光芒还在不断显现并且向其中汇聚！
每当有一束大道光芒靠近，镜子表面都会泛起轻微的涟漪，那些繁复的纹路也随之亮起，释放出更为璀璨的光辉。
但是这些光芒怎么看着这么眼熟？这不是刚才撞向我的那些光芒吗？
直到此时，林镜才发现了不对劲的地方，他好像莫名其妙变成一面镜子了？
【叮！恭喜宿主成为洪荒世界第一件混沌至宝！灵宝系统已绑定！】
content_en:
In the initial stage of chaos, the entire universe was still in a hazy state, and the concepts of time and space had not yet been fully formed.
In this chaos, the only thing that exists is the three thousand demon gods who contain the power of the great avenue. They are slowly gestating in the maternal energy of chaos, waiting for the day they break out of their shells. Each of the three thousand demon gods represents a different aspect of the avenue. They are not only the products of chaos, but also the founders of future order and law.
Chaos, as a shapeless and edgeless space, is filled with endless energy and possibilities.
The constant collision and fusion of these energies produced subtle reactions with the avenue, forming unique conditions for the birth of three thousand demon gods.
Each demon god contains a part of the true meaning of the avenue. They grow by absorbing the spiritual energy from chaos. Until one day, when their power reaches its peak, they will show their different forms and become independent individuals.
During this period, except for the three thousand demon gods, there were no other living creatures or consciousnesses in the chaos.
There are no stars, no life, and even the most basic concept of time has not yet been established. Everything is in an absolutely pristine state, with only pure energy and infinite possibilities flowing through it.
Just as chaos maintained its eternal silence, as if time had stood still, an unexpected occurrence completely broke the tranquility. A special existence, like a sudden meteor, broke through the thick curtain of chaos and broke into this ancient and mysterious space.
This existence did not come from within the chaos, but suddenly came from the outside world. It was Lin Jing's soul, a true spirit that did not belong here.
For Lin Jing, it all happened so suddenly and unbelievably. In his consciousness, he still remembered that one moment he was in the happy 996 middle school in modern society, and the next moment he was inexplicably in a void!
Surrounded by endless darkness and chaotic energy, with no direction, no reference, and even no gravity, he was like a lonely stardust, drifting aimlessly in the ocean of chaos.
Originally, Lin Jing thought he had just passed out from overexertion, but after he drifted in the chaos for several hours, he realized that this place no longer seemed to be the earth!
"Is it possible that I've traveled through time? But it's so dark all around, I can't see anything! Even the sound doesn't exist!"
These thoughts continue to echo in Lin Jing's true spirit, but in the chaos, he can't even speak now!
As time went by, Lin Jing gradually adapted to this peculiar way of existence.
He discovered that despite being in chaos, he could sense subtle fluctuations in the energy around him and even be able to interact with these energies to some extent.
But it was of no use, and as time went by, he felt that his consciousness was getting blurry!
It seems that his true spirit will soon dissipate!
According to the normal time-travel process, he should replace a living being in this world, or be reborn as a new living being!
But the current situation is very embarrassing. This is the newborn world of chaos. Except for the three thousand demon gods, no other living beings can be born at all!
And the three thousand demon gods who contain the power of the great avenue have already given birth to their own consciousness, which is not something that Lin Jing's weak soul can seize!
Fortunately, there is no sure path, just when Lin Jing's consciousness is about to dissipate! He seemed to hear a voice that existed in the dark!
"You are...what?"
"Shouldn't... appear in the chaos...?"
The sound was intermittent and finally turned into a complete question!
"What do you want?"
At this time, Lin Jing was almost driven crazy by the endless emptiness of the chaotic world, and he weakly conveyed an idea!
"I want to seeClear this world...the clearer the better! "
This time, the mysterious voice was silent for a long time, and finally responded:
"Okay! "
The next moment, the most dazzling light since its birth erupted in the chaos, and the power of three thousand avenues converged towards Lin Jing's direction, forming a huge vortex like thousands of rivers returning to the sea.
This force was so strong that it almost tore apart the barrier of chaos, making the originally chaotic world instantly brighter. Lin Jing felt a strong suction gripping his soul tightly, and was then brought into a whole new dimension.
In front of his eyes, chaos was no longer chaotic energy with no rules at all, but showed an orderly structure.
The power of the three thousand avenues seemed to turn into three thousand bright galaxies, rotating around him. Each galaxy represented the fundamental law of a kind of avenue. They were intertwined to form a complex and exquisite network.
Lin Jing was surprised to find that he could actually understand part of the meaning of these powers. He saw the passage of time, the extension of space, the composition of matter, the conversion of energy... everything was revealed under the influence of these three thousand powers.
The next moment, Lin Jing, who was still traveling among the three thousand avenues, came back to his senses and found that he could now see chaos clearly!
In the chaos, the three thousand demon gods who contain the power of the great avenue are still being gestated, but many of their true spirits have awakened and are paying attention to everything that happens here!
Lin Jing withdrew his gaze at this time and saw himself!
A gorgeous and simple mirror appeared in Lin Jing's spiritual consciousness. The front of this mirror was as smooth as jade, reflecting soft and clear light, giving people a gentle and gentle feeling.
Under the mirror, there seems to be endless chaos hidden. Just staring for a moment can make people feel awe. The back of the mirror is engraved with complex lines. These lines are not randomly carved, but are arranged and combined according to some mysterious rules, forming a series of complex totems and symbols.
This gorgeous mirror is floating alone in the chaos, and the lights of various avenues around it are still emerging and converging into it!
Whenever a beam of light approaches, slight ripples will appear on the surface of the mirror, and those complicated lines will also light up, releasing an even brighter brilliance.
But why do these lights look so familiar? Isn't this the light that hit me just now?
It was only then that Lin Jing discovered something was wrong. He seemed to have turned into a mirror inexplicably?
